published_statement: Zenginoglu 2404.01528 Sec. IV.A: 'parametrize Minkowski space by hyperbolas of different radii ... This approach goes back to Milne [34], who considered the resulting metric a cosmological model. ... Inside the light cone, Milne slices are spacelike curves and provide a time function. ... Milne time eta = sqrt(t^2 - x^2). ... Each slice has a constant mean extrinsic curvature, and the value of the curvature depends on time as K = 1/eta. ... we define the comoving coordinate chi via t = eta cosh chi and x = eta sinh chi. The metric becomes ds^2 = -deta^2 + eta^2 dchi^2. ... Milne time is restricted to inside the light cone.' Ling 2202.04014 Sec. 1.1: 'The Milne universe corresponds to the scale factor a(tau) = tau which isometrically embeds into Minkowski space' with g = -dtau^2 + a^2(tau)[dR^2 + sinh^2(R)(dtheta^2 + sin^2 theta dphi^2)], t = tau cosh R, r = tau sinh R, 'the spacetime manifold M lies within the set of points t^2 - r^2 > 0. Since t > 0 ... M lies within the set of points t > r', and eq. (1.10) 8pi rho/3 = (a'^2 - 1)/a^2, -8pi p = (2a''a + a'^2 - 1)/a^2, which vanish identically for a = tau.
published_hypotheses: The ambient spacetime is Minkowski (flat, metric eta); 1+1 in Zenginoglu, 3+1 in Ling.

The chart covers only the interior of the future light cone of the origin O: t > |r|, tau = sqrt(t^2 - r^2) > 0 (Zenginoglu: 'restricted to inside the light cone'; Ling: 'M lies within the set of points t > r').
The slices tau = const are the hyperboloids t^2 - r^2 = tau^2; their intrinsic geometry is hyperbolic space H^3 (k = -1), scale factor a(tau) = tau exactly.
Comoving observers chi = const are straight lines through O (Ling fig. 3); O itself is on no slice.
Zero stress-energy is a CONSEQUENCE (Ling eq. 1.10 with a = tau, k = -1 gives rho = p = 0), not an input; likewise flatness follows from the isometric embedding, not from Ricci-flatness.
Each slice has constant mean curvature K = 1/eta (2D; 3/tau in 3+1), and the slicing is not time-translation invariant (metric depends on tau).

SCOPE NARROWED LEGITIMATELY: Milne 1935 offered the chart as a cosmological model (kinematic relativity, an empty expanding universe); the tree uses only the chart of Minkowski. Data that rule out the Milne universe as our cosmos do not touch the tree's use.

later_literature.ref: A. Zenginoglu, Hyperbolic times in Minkowski space, arXiv:2404.01528v2 (2024), Sec. IV.A-IV.D
later_literature.what: Restates Milne slicing exactly and names its limits: slices intersect at null infinity (evolution field d_eta vanishes there), the slicing breaks time-translation symmetry (time-dependent metric), the light cone at O plays a unique role, outgoing null rays never reach the conformal boundary in Milne time (Fig. 7), and global energy is conserved on Milne slices rather than radiated -- contrasted with the time-shifted hyperboloidal foliation (t - tau)^2 - x^2 = L^2. Footnote 36: in higher dimensions Milne slices have the geometry of AdS time slices (H^3), which is what W = cosh chi encodes. None of this touches the tree's use, which is confined to one slice tau_0 = 1 and one ray.

later_literature.ref: E. Ling, Remarks on the cosmological constant appearing as an initial condition for Milne-like spacetimes, arXiv:2202.04014v3 (2022), Sec. 1.1-1.2
later_literature.what: Places the Milne universe a(tau) = tau as the exact-flat member of the Milne-like class a(tau) = tau + o(tau^{1+eps}), all conformal to a subset of Minkowski space (g = Omega^2 eta, b^2 = t^2 - r^2) with the big bang a coordinate singularity on the light cone; gives the Friedmann equations (1.10) from which rho = p = 0 follows for a = tau, k = -1 -- the source of the tree's T_ab = 0.

later_literature.ref: L. Lombriser, Cosmology in Minkowski space, arXiv:2306.16868 (2023)
later_literature.what: Restates that FLRW metrics with k != 0 are conformally flat and can be cast as a^2(T,R) eta with suitable T, R [refs 17-20 there], and that such reframings leave observables invariant -- consistent with the tree's 'same spacetime, two slicings' reading; does not name Milne.

later_literature.ref: Global stability of the open Milne spacetime, arXiv:2307.04405 (2023)
later_literature.what: Abstract: nonlinear stability of the open Milne spacetime (Cauchy surface isometric to hyperbolic space); establishes that the Milne background is a stable vacuum solution, which strengthens rather than narrows its standing as an exact witness.

later_literature.ref: P. LeFloch, Y. Ma, The hyperboloidal foliation method, arXiv:1411.4910 (2014)
later_literature.what: Uses the Milne-type hyperboloidal foliation of Minkowski space as the analytic frame for global existence of nonlinear wave-Klein-Gordon systems -- the same slicing, used as a tool rather than a cosmology.

later_literature.ref: M. Possel, Teaching cosmology with special relativity: piecewise inertial frames as a model for cosmic expansion, Eur. J. Phys. 40 (2019) (Zenginoglu ref [35])
later_literature.what: Pedagogical restatement of the Milne model as special relativity in disguise, cited by Zenginoglu beside Milne [34].

lacked_data: Milne (1935) lacked no datum this result depends on: the chart is a theorem of 1908 Minkowski geometry (hyperbolic rotation about O), and both restatements read here derive it with no parameter -- Ling eq. (1.10) gives rho = p = 0 identically for a = tau, and the rederive script gets Riemann = 0 and m = 0 with no number in. What Milne did lack was the later cosmological data (CMB, SN Ia, BAO) that exclude the Milne universe as a model of OUR cosmos (it is empty, Omega = 0, q = 0); that evidence bears on Milne's cosmological claim, which the tree does not use, and Ling 2020/2022 shows the Milne-like class survives regardless as a mathematical object. So M's hypothesis finds no purchase on this result: the one weakness found is not missing data but an unstated hypothesis inside the tree's own arithmetic (the comoving target behind the 3774 ratio), and that hypothesis is now named. Evidence either way: for -- none; against -- every source and every check above.
grade_evidence: Statement and hypotheses as used match the source restatements (chart, range t > |r|, tau > 0, hyperboloid slices, a = tau, k = -1). Re-derivation agrees: Riemann = 0 (256 components), Ric = 0, W = cosh chi, U = sinh chi, m = 0, m3 = -tau sinh^3 chi/2, C = 1/cosh chi, the V13-V15 flat-leaf identities, mean curvature 3/tau, and all 15 table entries plus the four pinned values at foliation.py:977-980 to <= 2e-5 relative from an independent light-cone construction; advance over flat computed (not set) = 0 to 1e-9. No datum enters, so nothing has moved. The two findings -- nonstatic.py proves Ricci-flat and names flat (closed here by Riemann = 0), and the flight ratio 3774 rests on a comoving target the prose does not state (its dependent rows cite only the target-independent claims) -- are named hypotheses, not narrowings of any claim a rests_on_it row uses.
